title: Deficiency Balance Accounts: Paydown Record and the Lump-Sum Settlement Percent
content:
**Rule.** The lump-sum paydown share of an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts is the total amount of the account's posted payments and applied credits, less the total amount of its returned payments, divided by the original deficiency. A lump-sum paydown share below 0.15 (15 percent) adds 4.0 percentage points to the lump-sum settlement percent, one of at least 0.15 but below 0.3 (30 percent) adds 2.0 points, and a larger one adds no points.

## Ladder

| Lump-sum paydown share | Points added |
|---|---|
| Below 0.15 | 4.0 |
| 0.15 up to but not including 0.3 | 2.0 |
| 0.3 or more | None |

## Points of judgement

- All posted payments and applied credits since opening enter the share, less every returned payment; the share is divided by the original deficiency on the opening date, never by the current balance.
- An account with no payment and no credit has a share of zero and falls in the first row.

## Worked shares (hypothetical; original deficiency $8,000.00)

| Paid down (payments plus credits less returns) | Share | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| $1,190.00 | 0.14875 | 4.0 |
| $1,200.00 | 0.15 | 2.0 |
| $2,390.00 | 0.29875 | 2.0 |
| $2,400.00 | 0.30 | None |
